achievement.label: Achievement
achievement.text: You're motivated by using your abilities and feeling a real sense of accomplishment in your work. Careers with visible results and skill growth tend to be a strong fit.

recognition.label: Recognition
recognition.text: You value advancement, being acknowledged for your work, and having a clear path to grow. Careers with visible progression and merit-based recognition tend to be a strong fit.

relationships.label: Relationships
relationships.text: You value getting along well with others, doing meaningful work for people, and a strong sense of ethics on the job. Careers built around teamwork and service tend to be a strong fit.

support.label: Support
support.text: You value fair treatment and good management — supervisors who back their team and help them grow. A well-run, supportive workplace matters a lot to how satisfied you'll be.

independence.label: Independence
independence.text: You value working things out your own way — trying your own ideas, making your own decisions, and working with minimal supervision. Careers with autonomy tend to be a strong fit.

workingConditions.label: Working Conditions
workingConditions.text: You value stability, variety, and a genuinely comfortable work environment day-to-day. How and where the work happens matters as much to you as what the work is.
